title: Agentforce Agents — Conversational AI for Salesforce Productivity
summary: Agentforce agents bring conversational AI to Salesforce, letting teams build customizable AI assistants and accelerate integrations via APIs to help users get more done in-platform.
evidence_snippet:
H1: Get Started with Agentforce Agents
Bring the power of conversational AI to your business with Agentforce agents. Build a trusted and customizable AI assistant that empowers your users to get more done in Salesforce. Accelerate your Agentforce integration with our APIs and other developer resources.

persona_relevance.why_it_matters: Conversational AI can automate routine sales tasks (data entry, meeting summaries, lead triage), freeing reps to sell more and improving throughput, conversion, and pipeline velocity.

action_suggestion: Run a pilot to deploy Agentforce assistants for a top sales pod to automate CRM updates and meeting summaries, and track time saved and uplift in opportunities per rep.
